_about: AO1990 Bases XV-XVII: compounds that lost their hyphen(s) because they are felt as a single lexical unit. This is lexical (not derivable from the prefix+r/s doubling rule, which is handled deterministically in rules.py). Forward (old->new) removes the hyphen; backward restores it for these lemmas.
_sources: Acordo Ortografico de 1990, Bases XV, XVI, XVII
_kept_note: 'cor-de-rosa' explicitly KEEPS its hyphens under Base XV (consecrated colour locution); listed here as an identity to document the exception.
